justification.text: `C > 1` is the problem's own constant range. proportionCoverable p k c is monotone in c (it counts sets coverable by at most c translates), so ∃ C > 1 is equivalent to ∃ C > 0; and a set of size k = ⌊p^θ⌋ with c translates covers at most k·c elements, below p whenever C ≤ 1, so no constant ≤ 1 could work. Green's own constants (100, and 1.01 in the registry's neighbouring variant) all exceed 1.
